policy.claim: F_D source re-entry normalization only; no semantic rewriting, completeness judgment, new F_P usage or semantic acceptance.
policy.equivalence: Collapse each maximal Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space; strip outer whitespace only. Preserve every non-whitespace character, case, punctuation and inter-character whitespace boundary.
policy.scope: Only quote/start_line/end_line inside the five known grounding arrays; section_id and all other fields remain unchanged.
policy.uniqueness: Exactly one normalized occurrence in the same supplied source section, including coordinate-only repairs. Already strict-valid anchors are unchanged without a recovery claim.
